integrity: A written universal proof is paired with a reproducible finite exact-arithmetic checker; no finite enumeration is used to infer an infinite-domain theorem. Independent scientific validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact unit-integer lattice, scalar linear contraction, ideal unbiased fresh rounding, nonnegative integer initial state. Does not cover floating-point grids, nonlinear maps, biased rounding, correlations or additive forcing.
title: Reciprocal-integer rigidity and exact absorption laws for stochastic rounding of contractions
